credibility.line: None of these promises can be checked against reported numbers yet — no score.

narrative_vs_numbers.point: Management guided high single-digit FY27 revenue growth, while reported Q1 and Q2 FY27 revenue grew 10.5% and 11.9% YoY.
Management touted strong Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin of 28.9%, but reported EBITDA margin declined YoY from 31.0% in Jun 2025.
Despite Sep 2026 revenue rising 11.9% YoY to ₹16,199 crore, reported PAT dropped 36.2% YoY to ₹1,995 crore.

bull: 5-year operating cash flow conversion stands strong at 120% of reported net profit.
Balance sheet remains virtually debt-free with a D/E ratio of 0.04 as of September 2026.
Sep 2026 quarterly revenue expanded 11.9% YoY to reach ₹16,199 crore.
bear: Sep 2026 quarter PAT dropped 36.2% YoY to ₹1,995 crore from ₹3,125 crore.
EBITDA margins contracted from 32.0% in Dec 2025 to 29.0% in Sep 2026.
Analysts highlighted sharp US generic revenue step-down and specialty growth deceleration in Q1 FY27.
watch: H2 FY27 revenue growth against the high single-digit guidance.
PAT margin recovery following the 36.2% YoY drop in Sep 2026.
Organon transaction closing progress targeted for Q4 FY27.
